result.title: Evo-B&B: Behavior-Aware LLM-Guided Joint Evolution of Branching and Node Selection Policies for MILP
result.summary: In branch-and-bound for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), branching and node selection are two critical and tightly coupled decisions, yet most existing learning-based approaches focus on optimizing them separately. We propose Evo-B&B, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework that jointly evolves executable branching and node selection policies using end-to-end SCIP solving feedback. To improve search efficiency and reduce redundant evaluations of behaviorally similar policies, Evo-B&B introduces a behavior-aware multi-island evolutionary mechanism. It measures policy similarity from branching and node-selection behaviors on a fixed set of B&B decision states and uses this similarity to preserve population diversity. We evaluate Evo-B&B on four standard MILP benchmarks across multiple instance scales. Experimental results show that Evo-B&B achieves competitive solving performance and generalizes well to larger-scale instances, while ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of joint evolution and behavior-aware diversity management.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Evo-B&B，一个 LLM 引导的进化框架，利用 SCIP 端到端求解反馈联合演化 MILP 的分支与节点选择策略，并引入行为感知的多岛机制，以固定决策状态集上的行为相似度维持种群多样性、减少冗余评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 「在固定决策状态集上度量策略行为相似度」的思路可能与 latent 推理步骤的相似度度量、内容与位置因素以及冗余假设筛选相通，LLM 引导的进化搜索加端到端求解反馈也或可供核查推理轨迹的贡献分配与验证设计；但该工作属组合优化领域，联系目前仅为推测。
